expo.name: PulseSense
expo.description: Offline health companion for vitals, medications, and emergency triage. 100% private, no account required.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PulseSense needs camera access to set your profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PulseSense needs photo library access to set your profile photo.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PulseSense uses your location to show your address on the emergency action screen.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: PulseSense reads your health data to track vitals and provide health insights.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: PulseSense writes your vital recordings to Apple Health.
